title: European NUTS2 employment across all published age groups
source: Eurostat lfst_r_lfe2emp and prior fixed regional THAIE linkage
note: 208-region descriptive cohort. Regional THAIE is conditional on disclosed and mapped occupational cells; it is not certified full-workforce exposure. Some ranks have very sparse support. Compare the ≥50-cell sensitivity; that screen is a support diagnostic, not proof of workforce coverage.
